title: CWP/21522/2025 of TAMANNA BABBAR Vs STATE OF HARYANA AND ORS
judge: HON'BLE MR. JUSTICE ANUPINDER SINGH GREWAL
text:
157(4) AT CHANDIGARH CWP No.21522 of 2025 (O&M) Date of Decision: 29.07.2025 TAMANNA BABBAR .....Petitioner Versus STATE OF HARYANA AND ORS ........Respondents CORAM : HON'BLE MR. JUSTICE ANUPINDER SINGH GREWAL HON'BLE MR. JUSTICE DEEPAK MANCHANDA Present: Mr. Nishant Maini, Advocate, for the petitioner. ANUPINDER SINGH GREWAL, J. (Oral) Learned counsel for the petitioner submits that the petitioner had been allotted the plot but the possession of the same has not been delivered to her till date. He further submits that the petitioner has sent a representation dated 18.06.2025 (Annexure P-3) in this regard and prays that this petition be disposed of with a direction to respondent No.4 to consider and decide the same expeditiously.

2. Issue notice to the respondents.

3. Mr. Deepak Bhardwaj, Advocate, accepts notice on behalf of respondents No.2 to 4.

4. Heard.

5. In view of the limited prayer, this petition is disposed of with direction to respondent No.4 to consider and decide the representation (Annexure P-3) preferred by the petitioner, expeditiously preferably within a period of three months from the date of receipt of certified copy of this order. (ANUPINDER SINGH GREWAL) JUDGE (DEEPAK MANCHANDA) 29.07.2025 JUDGE sandeep Whether Speaking/Reasoned : Yes/No
